## Diff-minimization assessment

RETAIN. All assigned escort.c hunks 11-86 were read (744 added/deleted lines). These complete the removal of old routing setup/selection and introduce docking/recall, cage ownership, goal policy and the first part of physical route creation. Preserve native object/AI ownership and the existing route module rather than create another facade carrying the same private globals

Docked companions are deliberately hidden OBJ_GHOST/CT_NONE/MT_NONE/RT_NONE objects with a valid companion definition. Refresh does not treat a docked buddy as absent; active and docked queries are separate. Dock/deploy clears goals and motion, relinks to the eligible owner's ship, drops cooperative robot control while docked, then restores model/physics/AI/control on deploy. Spawn requests and ownership generations stay in the native multiplayer owner. Recall admits the owner command, clears prior route/secret/path state and selects AIM_GOTO_PLAYER; its frame-time completion is in the next assigned unit

Cage-release attribution is limited to the companion cage or adjacent segments, valid playing candidates and unclaimed cooperative ownership. Release prefers the recorded eligible releaser, otherwise the first eligible player. Docked companions cannot speak. This is source-level authority/lifecycle evidence, not a real-peer reorder/disconnect validation

Completion guards preserve the fuel-center sentinel while rejecting unrelated negative/object-overrun indices. Enhanced hostage goals complete only on a hostage; intermediate pickups retain the request. Enhanced-only commands expose pending work instead of changing to unrelated fallback behavior. KEY_9 can adopt an explicit exit route, with shared goal messaging and native direct-command recording retained

Path creation distinguishes the semantic goal from its physically reachable endpoint. Current boss position and hostage prerequisite identity remain explicit. The existing readiness policy rejects nonpathable requests. Avoid-edge recovery uses its existing helper, clears failed avoidance before fallback, and invokes the route constructor only for route goals. Original selection/path creation remains native. The partial-path continuation is completed in GQ2-0224; no full-function success is claimed from this half alone

The deleted key/reactor/route helpers have their current policy owners; imported native trigger exit queries preserve compound source semantics. Existing BR-0374 cooperative control, BR-0382 secret selection, BR-0384 menu preview/activation, BR-0332 route state, BR-0294 diagnostics and GQR-0197 path scratch remain open. No new candidate or duplicated issue is admitted

## Diff-minimization assessment

RETAIN the narrow native module boundary, with local interface cleanup GQF-0262/GQR-0248. All 168 assigned header lines were read. The mode values, semantic route goal, unexplored target and native services are engine-owned, including the separate ROUTE_PLANNER and LIVE_ESCORT build capabilities

The header currently exposes 65 state variables. A current tracked C/C++ source/header census finds 52 referenced only by guidebot_route.c and this header. A second git grep across all tracked non-Markdown files confirms that the 52 names occur only in those two files, covering scripts and build files as well as native sources. Every one of the 65 variables and all 33 function declarations has exactly one definition across escort.c, guidebot_route.c, guidebot_routing.c and aipath.c

Make those 52 owner-only definitions static, remove their extern declarations and the resulting empty INTROSPECT_ON header block. The exact draft removes 55 header/product lines (52 declarations plus empty guard/separator) and leaves 13 genuinely shared variables. It does not remove any live state, change initialization, serialization, counters, getter APIs or introspection controls, and adds no accessors. The two introspection suppression variables already have owner-local public setter/getter services; those remain unchanged. Zero inherited-file savings: both edited files are branch-added

Provisional impact rating: 33 (H/M/B/C/R = 12/0/4/10/7); proposed owner: GQR-0248; rationale: concrete unnecessary state exposure, complete tracked reference census and exact local draft, with build/link checks across preprocessor variants still required

The retained state includes semantic goal/unexplored state, mode restore, externally updated owner/boss/object counters and path-recovery edge identity. Keeping the goal object visible where the existing native path and overlay consumers require it avoids replacing a small real boundary with dozens of wrappers. Remaining diagnostics/state-layout cleanup is not inferred from this census

D2 desktop and replay/live tests enable both planner and live escort; route-only and metadata-only headless targets intentionally differ. Validation of the proposed linkage cleanup must build those variants plus Android and the ordinary maintained navigation tests, with one scoped quality pass. This source-only review does not claim fresh runtime validation or whole guidebot_route.c coverage

## Event and diagnostic evidence

Notifications advance nonzero generations but only authoritative, relevant work dirties the route. An in-flight metadata job receives a coalesced deferred event mask instead of repeated restart; completion scheduling merges it back after the pending job finishes. The five-domain audit rotates at quarter-second cadence and skips automap outside unexplored mode. Its call site is behind authority and active-goal checks. Explicit target changes invalidate live work; Original forces end-of-level mode. Retain these distinctions and the existing BR-0332 metadata/cache owner

BR-0381 observational-probe evidence is extended. Current create_path_points and route-path probes pass safety insertion off, correcting the historical private-buffer/global-arena safety path described in that finding. Nevertheless escort_debug_compare_route_path L1284 calls escort_route_clear_goal, which also resets Escort_hostage_object, Escort_hostage_signature, Escort_hostage_next_plan and Escort_route_goal_request_pending. If a cache improvement is pending, the clear consumes it, sets metadata dirty and changes last-replan reason. The diagnostic saves/restores Escort_route_goal, selected AI state and RNG, but none of those additional fields. An ordinary parity command while hostage/cache/request state is active can therefore change route runtime while its limited restored_state_match still reports success

This is static, directly traced evidence under the existing requirement that the probe be observational, not a fresh runtime mismatch or a new finding. Extend BR-0381 acceptance to all state touched through clear-goal/callees and the full live path/AI/RNG transaction. Prefer avoiding unrelated clear side effects or restoring the complete affected state without adding another incomplete snapshot. Existing GQR-0197 owns allocation admission separately. Bounded ordinary pre/post state checks remain required when fixing; no adversarial, allocation-failure or pressure probes were run

## Goal, cache and notification evidence

Trigger latch updates are bounded by MAX_TRIGGERS and honor diagnostic suppression; the general event path separately checks enhanced mode and authority. An unapplied draft moves the existing body into cmake/dxx-sdl-mixer-runtime.cmake with one target parameter, preserving the hand-written loader comment, all predicates, list order, generator expressions, configure-time existence check, POST_BUILD phase and install destination. Each inherited file retains an include and one call. The draft removes 22 inherited-file lines; its 17-line helper leaves only five net repository lines removed. This is deliberately modest, not a large repository simplification, and it adds no game-runtime API

Fresh CMake 3.31.6/MSVC x86 configure-only fixtures compare the actual original blocks with the exact draft helper for two executable targets. Debug and Release each generate 12 copy commands and 12 install rules, while SDLMIXER=OFF generates none. After replacing only fixture source/build directory prefixes, before/after generated rules are byte-identical in all three modes. Six configurations succeed without warnings. Placeholder DLL names establish presence checks; they are never built as codecs, copied, loaded or installed. git apply --check passes

These results establish the extraction's generated rule equivalence in the bounded fixture, not actual packaged game runtime or other platform builds. +include_guard(GLOBAL)

+function(dxx_copy_sdl_mixer_runtime target)
+    if(SDLMIXER AND MSVC AND VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR AND VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET)
+        set(VCPKG_PREFIX "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}")
+        # SDL_mixer loads these codecs dynamically, so vcpkg's import scan misses them
+        set(MUSIC_DLL_DIR "${VCPKG_PREFIX}/$<IF:$<CONFIG:Debug>,debug/bin,bin>")
+        foreach(lib mpg123 FLAC mikmod ogg vorbis vorbisfile)

+            endif()

+endfunction()

Native recovery distinguishes a surviving process from a replacement game. Migration alternates survivors and checks advertised address, port, game and in-game state before return; final abort requires the advertisement to retire without replacing the surviving process. Background rejoin checks launcher continuity and foreground service after normal foreground return. ## Diff-minimization assessment and evidence

Disposition: RETAIN; existing generation-identity finding only

SC88 tail, SC88Pro, PlayStation, SunSpire and D2 Arachno/MU80/OPL3/SC55 plus opening SC88. Empty Infinite Abyss and MacPlay album shells document physical-disc filtering. The two D2 SC55 omitted names are documented indistinguishable candidates, not missing JSON entries

The entire 3,251-line generated catalog was reviewed as one coherent five-unit batch. Parsed every field and reviewed a source-line-indexed semantic projection of all 366 records and every comment. The 2,145,131 opaque fingerprint characters were checked by exact source equality, alphabet validation, length and SHA-256, not visually interpreted or natively decoded. Exact unredacted range hashes below preserve the queue boundaries, including records crossing them

Fresh bounded checks account for all 35 source files and 580 source tracks: 366 published and 214 omitted. IDs are nonempty, unique case-insensitively and disjoint from 36 physical-disc IDs; actual PowerShell source-ID/uniqueness helpers pass. Every published track number is unique within its album and preserves its source position. Names, fingerprint bytes, positive integer durations and every published optional metadata field equal the corresponding checked-in source. Actual PowerShell title matching accepts all 36 published AcoustID labels. This proves source-to-asset consistency, not the external correctness of cached recording attribution

All 214 omitted tracks have exactly one explanatory comment: 105 physical-disc duplicates and 109 ambiguous album candidates. Each referenced source/target track exists; duplicate targets are fingerprinted audio records. Every ambiguity comment preserves source names and a duration-compatible pair at recorded score 1; 105 of 109 also have byte-identical encoded fingerprints. Four require native similarity evidence to revalidate their recorded score, which was not rerun. No duration-compatible exact fingerprint collision remains among published album entries. This is not an all-pairs native similarity/false-positive proof

The inspected publisher owns ordinal album ordering, source IDs, per-source track positions, physical-disc priority, ambiguity exclusion, metadata selection and normalized no-change publication. Keep the generated asset separate from physical-disc hashes, with comments and empty album shells preserving why source recordings are excluded. Moving these data into inherited D1/D2 files, renumbering tracks after omissions, adding a compatibility catalog, or hand-minifying payloads would not reduce inherited merge pressure. The assigned JSONC file is added at the GQ2 base/head pair; Git reports the old JSON5 separately deleted, not a detected rename. This batch covers only the assigned JSONC ranges

FingerprintBridge reads both actual assets, prefers explicit tracklist titles, filters inconsistent AcoustID labels and falls back to maintained names/track numbers. Its first-(fingerprint,duration) projection still discards distinct provenance before native matching: existing GQF-0222/GQR-0207 remains open. Fresh selected JVM tests pass for actual KCXF2 tracklist titles and MacPlay's 13 useful names/track numbers 2..14. The latter verifies current projection behavior and does not prove the first-provenance policy correct. Exactly two methods ran, not the complete contract class

Generation metadata is still absent from the catalog root and checked-in source projection. Exact equality with current source files cannot prove which source media, decoder/tool build, algorithm and policy generated those sources. Carry existing GQF-0030/GQR-0017; do not admit a duplicate finding or claim it repaired. Existing GQR-0046 ranking precision and GQR-0047 asymmetric exact-collision duration policy remain separate publisher concerns. This inspection confirms the ratio-based predicate in the current publisher but does not execute order/boundary probes or close either owner

Fresh offline JDK21 :app:testDebugUnitTest succeeds in 51 seconds, 34 tasks with six executed and 28 up-to-date. The two named cases have zero failures/errors/skips; existing Gradle deprecation notice remains and no new compile warning appears. No product/test-source edits, full APK/native build, audio loading, fingerprint decoder/matcher invocation, source regeneration, external AcoustID lookup, device operation or deferred adversarial/security/malformed-media/resource-pressure probes ran. Existing input/audio changes remain untouched

Reviewed the whole assigned diffs using parsed before/after field comparison, exact full-diff hashes and per-file changes. Across the three units there are 34 files: 31 fingerprint manifests and three track-hash manifests, 221 actual diff hunks and 514 added/deleted lines. The historical queue's one-line-per-path display is an inventory estimate, not the reviewed delta size. Every assigned current file equals its frozen GQ2 head

The complete semantic delta is 256 SHA-1 replacements and one acoustid_album correction. All old/new SHA-1 values have 40 lowercase hex characters. Every other parsed field is exactly equal before/after: track numbering/type, encoded chromaprint bytes, durations, titles and optional extraction/filesystem metadata. Encoded fingerprints are opaque and were compared exactly, not decoded or visually interpreted. The sole label change is Definitive Collection USA Disc 2 track 7, from Descent II: The Infinite Abyss to Descent II: The Definitive Collection, consistent with that source folder; no external AcoustID attribution query ran

For every assigned manifest, its paired current track_hashes/track_fingerprints file has exactly the same numbered track set, type and SHA-1 values. The Infinite Abyss hash manifest additionally retains its non-track SOW extraction record unchanged. Its track count is nine, not the raw ten-element JSON array length. Mac manifests retain HFS/data extraction fields and their full numbered audio lists. No records were deleted, renumbered, collapsed by digest or migrated to another schema

The inspected catalog merger indexes audio fingerprints by SHA-1 and projects fingerprint/duration/AcoustID metadata into matching catalog records. Rekeying therefore changes which identity those existing fingerprints claim, despite unchanged encoded payloads. Paired metadata equality is useful consistency evidence but cannot prove that a hash or fingerprint was generated from the intended disc sectors. Existing GQR-0017 source/tool/algorithm generation identity stays open. In the Anniversary unit, GQR-0016 remains open: current paired data-track identity agrees but no fresh raw source or decoded audio evidence closes its historical fingerprint concern. Earlier catalog review GQ2-0267..0270 contains merger dry-run evidence; it is historical here and was not rerun

## Diff-minimization assessment and evidence

Disposition: RETAIN

Four complete MacPlay/ARACHNO/MU80/OPL3 D1 manifests, 566 lines and 98 tracks. Retain four MacPlay physical-disc omissions, all MIDI variants and four OPL3 shareware versions; filename spelling and durations remain original source metadata

Reviewed every field and both generator comments in all 24 assigned files through a complete line-indexed semantic projection. Root shapes are album/tracks only; filenames are unique case-insensitively within each source, positive durations are integral milliseconds, optional scores are within 0..1 and recording IDs have the expected textual shape. All 418 named local audio files exist. Existence and schema checks do not authenticate or decode their payloads

The manifests contain 2,227,005 encoded fingerprint characters. These strings were compared exactly with published payloads and hashed for complete source projections, not visually interpreted or natively decoded. All 313 published tracks retain their exact source-derived track number, basename, duration, fingerprint and every published optional field. Every one of the other 105 source records has one current catalog explanation: 101 physical-disc duplicate references resolve to existing fingerprinted audio tracks, and four ambiguity references resolve to corresponding source tracks with compatible durations. The four encoded ambiguity pairs are not byte-equal; their stored native score of 1 was not recomputed. Physical duplicate labels describe prior approximate-match decisions, not fresh byte-equality evidence

Actual shared PowerShell JSONC parsing agrees with the independent projection for all 418 filenames, durations and fingerprint hashes. Actual Test-DxxAcoustIdTitleMatch evaluates all 97 source labels: 96 accepted, one rejected. For every retained track its result matches the packaged label policy. The sole rejected pair is D1 SC55 04 Escape.mp3 versus the cached End Level Theme label; the track remains published without that label. The source producer permits fingerprint-stable legacy cache metadata, while the album publisher applies maintained-title policy. Preserve this distinction; source and packaged optional fields need not be identical

Inspected fingerprint_music_packs.ps1 extraction reuse/flattening, source enumeration, complete native result assertion, fingerprint-stable cached metadata reuse, lookup branching and normalized sidecar publication. Inspected update_known_discs_albums.ps1 source-ID/ordered-file projection, maintained-title filtering, exact-encoded collision augmentation, physical-disc priority and optional-field output. Full generator/native matcher bodies did not run. Source discovery includes MP3/OGG/FLAC despite folder labels containing mp3, and SC55 has deliberate MP3 plus OGG entries. The two SC55 directory labels differ from embedded names only in case; IDs use normalized album text. An initial checker assumption of exact directory spelling was corrected, as was its assumption that every source AcoustID field must be republished; these were harness assumptions, not data defects

Retain branch-owned source manifests, comments, optional reviewed metadata, historical names/typos, ordering and distinct renderings. All assigned sources equal frozen head and are absent from the original inherited tree. Hand-minification, filename correction or source-track removal would obscure provenance without shrinking inherited engine changes. Even an album currently filtered to zero published tracks remains meaningful input to a future producer run

Existing GQF-0030/GQR-0017 remains open: these roots carry no source inventory/digests or decoder/native/tool/Chromaprint/algorithm/schema/policy generation identity. A current consistent projection does not establish freshness. Existing GQR-0046 lossless ranking, GQR-0047 symmetric duration policy, GQR-0207 distinct-identity projection, GQR-0223 string-aware JSONC readers and BR-0612 typed serialization remain separately owned. No new finding or additive inherited-file saving is admitted

Fresh checks are read-only metadata operations with scratch outputs. No media payload hash, audio decode, fingerprint generation/matching, AcoustID/network lookup, corpus regeneration, JVM/full build/device execution or deferred adversarial/security/malformed-media/resource-pressure probe ran. Earlier actual-asset JVM and album-catalog checks remain historical context only. Concurrent audio/input work and outstanding_bugs.md remain untouched

Provisional impact rating: 47 (H/M/B/C/R = 23/0/7/10/7); proposed owner: GQR-0017; rationale: existing source-generation freshness owner, reference only, zero inherited saving

## Diff-minimization assessment and evidence

Disposition: RETAIN

Eight complete D1/D2 MIDI, PlayStation, SunSpire, Infinite Abyss and MacPlay manifests, 654 lines and 94 tracks. Preserve source metadata even when the packaged Infinite Abyss/MacPlay albums have no retained tracks; D1 briefing remains a recorded approximate ambiguity

Reviewed every field and both generator comments in all 24 assigned files through a complete line-indexed semantic projection. Root shapes are album/tracks only; filenames are unique case-insensitively within each source, positive durations are integral milliseconds, optional scores are within 0..1 and recording IDs have the expected textual shape. All 418 named local audio files exist. Existence and schema checks do not authenticate or decode their payloads

The manifests contain 2,227,005 encoded fingerprint characters. These strings were compared exactly with published payloads and hashed for complete source projections, not visually interpreted or natively decoded. All 313 published tracks retain their exact source-derived track number, basename, duration, fingerprint and every published optional field. Every one of the other 105 source records has one current catalog explanation: 101 physical-disc duplicate references resolve to existing fingerprinted audio tracks, and four ambiguity references resolve to corresponding source tracks with compatible durations. The four encoded ambiguity pairs are not byte-equal; their stored native score of 1 was not recomputed. Physical duplicate labels describe prior approximate-match decisions, not fresh byte-equality evidence

Actual shared PowerShell JSONC parsing agrees with the independent projection for all 418 filenames, durations and fingerprint hashes. Actual Test-DxxAcoustIdTitleMatch evaluates all 97 source labels: 96 accepted, one rejected. For every retained track its result matches the packaged label policy. The sole rejected pair is D1 SC55 04 Escape.mp3 versus the cached End Level Theme label; the track remains published without that label. The source producer permits fingerprint-stable legacy cache metadata, while the album publisher applies maintained-title policy. Preserve this distinction; source and packaged optional fields need not be identical

Inspected fingerprint_music_packs.ps1 extraction reuse/flattening, source enumeration, complete native result assertion, fingerprint-stable cached metadata reuse, lookup branching and normalized sidecar publication. Inspected update_known_discs_albums.ps1 source-ID/ordered-file projection, maintained-title filtering, exact-encoded collision augmentation, physical-disc priority and optional-field output. Full generator/native matcher bodies did not run. Source discovery includes MP3/OGG/FLAC despite folder labels containing mp3, and SC55 has deliberate MP3 plus OGG entries. The two SC55 directory labels differ from embedded names only in case; IDs use normalized album text. An initial checker assumption of exact directory spelling was corrected, as was its assumption that every source AcoustID field must be republished; these were harness assumptions, not data defects

Retain branch-owned source manifests, comments, optional reviewed metadata, historical names/typos, ordering and distinct renderings. All assigned sources equal frozen head and are absent from the original inherited tree. Hand-minification, filename correction or source-track removal would obscure provenance without shrinking inherited engine changes. Even an album currently filtered to zero published tracks remains meaningful input to a future producer run

Existing GQF-0030/GQR-0017 remains open: these roots carry no source inventory/digests or decoder/native/tool/Chromaprint/algorithm/schema/policy generation identity. A current consistent projection does not establish freshness. Existing GQR-0046 lossless ranking, GQR-0047 symmetric duration policy, GQR-0207 distinct-identity projection, GQR-0223 string-aware JSONC readers and BR-0612 typed serialization remain separately owned. No new finding or additive inherited-file saving is admitted

Fresh checks are read-only metadata operations with scratch outputs. No media payload hash, audio decode, fingerprint generation/matching, AcoustID/network lookup, corpus regeneration, JVM/full build/device execution or deferred adversarial/security/malformed-media/resource-pressure probe ran. ## Diff-minimization assessment and evidence

Disposition: RETAIN

Three whole workflows plus all 49 assigned desktop/orchestrator hunks. Retain paired host coverage, platform-specific packaging and isolated universal CI APK. Nine YAML documents, five reusable calls, 23 immutable-shaped action references and 55 shell bodies checked locally. The repository baseline contains the older desktop workflows; they are not 1996 engine implementation files. Preserve platform-specific commands rather than introduce a shared wrapper solely to reduce YAML. No measured original-engine reduction is available

Tooling covers Linux/Windows, explicit 15-minute job limits, bounded diagnostic retention and a pinned actionlint download/hash declaration. The local Prettier YAML parser accepts every complete assigned workflow without duplicate mapping keys; all five package-all relative workflow targets exist and declare workflow_call. All 23 external action references have full 40-hex identities. This proves local shape and graph consistency, not remote action availability, executable identity, runner-image capabilities or hosted CI success. No actionlint binary was available locally, and none was downloaded

Engine smoke separately configures D1/D2 Debug, SDL dummy devices, explicit native features and all targets. CTest runs serially, with per-test timeout and --no-tests=error, and uploads diagnostics even after failure. Desktop packaging calls paired RelWithDebInfo builds/tests before producing platform artifacts; artifacts fail when missing. Both top-level CMake files include CTest outside Android and register shared native tests. Existing GQF-0009/GQR-0004 remains: the registered escort exit policy still uses four assert calls that optimized builds can disable; Debug smoke is useful but does not repair that independent release-test oracle

MSVC passes its x64/x86 developer environment and matching VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET. The x86-release preset name is not proof of an x64 defect: its architecture strategy is external and the invoked environment chooses cl.exe. The explicit command-line configuration overrides preset Release with RelWithDebInfo. Retain per-architecture vcpkg file cache and separate symbol artifacts. MinGW uses clang/lld, and paired current CMake branches request CodeView and PDB output; the PDB artifact requirement is deliberate. Linux/macOS package scripts and distinct Intel/ARM runner labels remain platform boundaries. Platform execution, symbol contents and package deployment were not validated here

Android packaging is manually dispatched, uses a separate com.dxxredux.app.ci application ID, and builds release-mode direct-install sources with all three ABIs. Current app/build.gradle maps ciApk to githubRelease, excludes normal release signing configuration for this variant, declares arm32/arm64/x86_64 and keeps release minification disabled. Workflow code checks package/debuggable state, verifies the selected signing mode, checks ELF magic/machine for both engines and runtime libraries, excludes Play SDK string prefixes and emits APK hashes. Test-key/default-branch selection and secret handling were read statically only; no secret value, keystore or auth file was read and no signing/release operation ran. Existing dependency bootstrap owners BR-0558/0563/0610 retain their independent tool-selection/provenance obligations

Fresh shell checks parse 44 bash/MSYS bodies using Git Bash -n and eleven PowerShell bodies using the PS7 AST parser. ## Revalidated finding and fix

- Live HEAD e833b7b337b9f216f5d3f98b6af43ec55bb93f07. GQR-0192 shared RNG ownership remains open; its referenced BR-0361 prerequisite still exists in both current native RNG files

- Each native fix adds a local has_state_after, assigns it and the post-state in a full expression after seeding, then passes the local to the recorder. Exact enclosing-file comparison proves these are the only native changes; all RNG state transitions, draw records, counters, stream selection, libc behavior and D2-specific diagnostics stay unchanged

Explicitly select unit zero before output binding/filter finalization; existing final active-unit restoration stays unchanged. Reuse current runtime adapter; no new state, callback or cache
- Exact whole-file source transformation verifies only these reorderings and ten added lines in existing shared Android owner. No inherited file changes. Shader, UV orientation, source filters, framebuffer transaction, cache policy, failure paths, diagnostic code and native wrappers remain unchanged

# BR-0197 Android xmodel mipmap generation remediation 20261008

- Revalidated accepted BR-0197 against current paired xmodel sources at HEAD 1ee56908299b870fef1852c3f0e7586844890652. Android GLES3 uploads used removed GL_GENERATE_MIPMAP and skipped explicit generation while requesting mipmapped filtering
- Changed exactly two preprocessor guards per game. Android skips the invalid legacy parameter and generates mipmaps after uploading level zero. Desktop and non-Android OGLES branches are unchanged. Zero net product lines; no new helper, cache, callback or abstraction
- Maintained actual ASE/TGA enhanced-model fixture covers RGB/RGBA, 8x8 POT and 15x13 NPOT, base/team textures and two EGL context generations in each actual game library. All 32 old-library records have GL_INVALID_ENUM and wrong minified pixels; all 32 repaired records have GL_NO_ERROR and equal their nonempty uniform level-zero reference. Reference hashes are preserved and recreated contexts agree
- Fixture correction: use explicit unpack alignment 1 for tightly packed generated RGB data, restoring the previous value. Default unpack alignment 4 exposes a separate native odd-width RGB upload defect; it remains open in the resume plan. This repair does not claim to fix that defect. Native-font interleaving fixture also now uses normalized native coordinates and asserts nonempty reference pixels; all 42 helper and eight enhanced/native binding failures per game remain independently reproduced after mipmap repair
- Full paired Windows builds and all three Android Debug native ABI builds pass, as do scoped mixed quality, final fixture quality, catalog validation/integration and owned diff check. Existing 1676 cache/wrap/label/batch records remain unchanged
- Maintained test_android_xmodel_mipmaps runner uses common isolated actual-engine fixture wiring, registered in graphics_scenarios with 600-second timeout. No Activity, retail media, allocation pressure, generation-failure fallback, malformed media or full gameplay replay claim. Preserve GQR-0178/0185 and BR-0304, concurrent installer/import/outstanding-bugs edits; no staging or commit

# GQR-0238 coherent texture binding ownership remediation 20261008

- Revalidated accepted GQR-0238 / reopened BR-0256 at live HEAD 1ee56908299b870fef1852c3f0e7586844890652 after preserving BR-0197 mipmap repair and the completed GQR-0178/0185 and BR-0304 changes. Baseline uses actual engine GLES libraries, not the older GL stand-in
- Existing GLES shim now owns three per-unit texture handles with separate known flags and actual active-unit tracking. Raw bind/active/delete redirects unconditionally execute GL and track transitions. Cached helpers reuse only known matching 2D bindings. Null adapters still bind unconditionally. Other valid units always bind; other texture targets do not overwrite 2D knowledge. Deletion invalidates all matching slots
- Native adapters retain only existing bind/reuse counter pointers. Removed both private arrays, active-unit variables, obsolete scalar resets and scalar filter adapter fields. Frame resets invalidate binding knowledge without inventing active unit zero. Shim initialization queries actual active unit and valid unit range; shutdown invalidates tracking. Internal diagnostic probe uses tracked wrappers explicitly
- Exact paired native transformation, shared remainder token checks and original-attribution metrics pass. Removed 12 inherited lines; original ogl.c additions D1 1858 -> 1852 and D2 1951 -> 1945, deletions unchanged at 76 each. Overall product grows 21 net lines to repair raw-transition tracking; this is not a net product deletion. Maintained fixture/structural-contract updates are separate test cost
- Preserved post-BR-0197 baseline has 68 cases/game, including 42 helper binding failures and eight wrong native-font pixel interleavings/game. Final actual fixture has 80 cases/game, all correct. Native-font reference hashes remain unchanged and nonempty; upload/base/team/free interleavings now match them. Valid reuse/counters, null/second adapter, raw bind/unit changes, filters 0/1/2, deletion/reallocation and transient reset covered
- Twelve added controls/game cover reset on unit two, cross-adapter reuse, deletion on all three tracked units, fourth-unit fallback, cube-map target isolation and actual initialization on nonzero unit two. Two actual recreated EGL contexts agree in both games. Deletion/reallocation uses actual generated names; no claim that the driver recycled the same numeric name
- Preprocessed ten actual Android engine translation units spanning all seven raw caller files. Only the three shim wrapper bodies retain raw GL bind/active/delete calls after excluding GL declarations; enhanced models, compositor, filters and external diagnostics use the shared owner. Seven maintained renderer contracts pass after updating the stale structural assumptions
- Full paired Windows builds and all three Android Debug native ABI builds pass. Scoped mixed and final lifecycle fixture quality, catalog validation/integration and owned diff checks pass. No changed-source warnings. All 1708 existing mipmap/cache/wrap/label/batch records remain byte-identical
- Maintained test_android_texture_bindings runner registered in graphics_scenarios with 600-second timeout. Baseline was captured before the adapter ABI change; final fixture adds explicit owner/lifecycle controls. No arbitrary simultaneous contexts, live Activity lifecycle, invalid GL inputs, driver allocation pressure, malformed media or full gameplay replay claim. Separate default-alignment odd-width RGB upload issue remains open in resume plan. Concurrent installer/import/outstanding-bugs work preserved; no staging or commit
